set.body: Audit GraphKernels.jl source semantics, pin an exact Julia environment and source revision, generate versioned fixtures for deliberately aligned WL behavior, and extend to shortest path only after E6 semantics align. set.title: Build the pinned GraphKernels.jl compatibility court
